data: Amazon held far more cash and cash equivalents than Apple in fiscal 2024. Amazon reported about $78.8 billion at December 31, 2024, while Apple reported about $29.9 billion at the end of its fiscal year on September 28, 2024. That makes Amazon's balance roughly 2.6 times Apple's ($78.8 billion divided by $29.9 billion). The comparison covers only the cash and cash equivalents line. Apple also held large current and non-current marketable securities, so its total liquidity is much bigger than its cash line alone suggests. These figures are from my memory of the companies' 10-K filings, so please check them against the filings before relying on them.
